reviews.title: Second time wasn't the charm
reviews.comment: Order 1 refurbished unit, it didn't make a sound and wasn't detected by BIOS or Windows 10 on two servers. Had a repplace sent out, it made loud banging sounds (probably the drive head) and also wasn't detected by BIOS or Windows 10 on two servers. Whoever is refurbishing these western digital drives is doing a piss poor job in quality control.
